Part of [M: Musculo-skeletal system](../).

**Bone markers and density are asynchronous.**
Antiresorptives move serum CTX long before bone mineral density, and an indirect response model bridges the lag, predicting later density gain from one year of data [@wuQuantitativePredictionBone2021].
